description_en: You can call the DescribeDBClusterAttribute operation to view the details of a specified AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBClusterAttribute接口查看目标AnalyticDB MySQL版集群的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-attribute --db-cluster-id am-bp111m2cfrdl10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

Category.description_en:
The edition of the cluster. Valid values:

BASIC: Basic Edition for reserved mode

CLUSTER: Cluster Edition for reserved mode

MIXED_STORAGE: Cluster Edition for flexible mode (new)

For more information about cluster editions, see [Editions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）
Category.description_zh:
产品系列，取值说明：
BASIC：预留模式基础版
CLUSTER：预留模式集群版
MIXED_STORAGE：弹性模式集群版（新版）

更多关于集群系列的介绍，请参见[产品系列]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）

CommodityCode.description_en:
The billing method of the product. Valid values:

ads: pay-as-you-go

ads_pre: subscription
CommodityCode.description_zh:
商品付费类型，取值说明：
ads：按量付费商品。
ads_pre：包年包月商品

ComputeResource.description_en: The specifications of computing resources used in the cluster that is in flexible mode. These resources are used for data computing. You can increase the computing resources to accelerate queries. You can scale the resources based on the actual performance of the cluster
ComputeResource.description_zh: 弹性模式下使用的计算资源规格，用于数据计算。增加计算资源能加快查询速度，可以根据集群实际性能按需弹性扩缩

ConnectionString.description_en: The VPC endpoint of the cluster

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster

DBClusterNetworkType.description_en: The network type of the cluster. Only VPC is supported
DBClusterNetworkType.description_zh: 集群网络类型。仅支持VPC（专有网络）类型

DBClusterStatus.description_en: The status of the cluster. For more information, see [Cluster states]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143075.html）
DBClusterStatus.description_zh: 集群状态。更多详情，请参见[集群状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143075.html）

DBClusterType.description_en:
The type of the cluster. Valid values:

Common: a regular cluster.

RDS_ANALYSIS: an analytic instance for MySQL. <props="china">For more information, see [What is an analytic instance for MySQL?]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）.</props>
DBClusterType.description_zh:
集群类型。取值说明：
Common：常规集群。
RDS_ANALYSIS：MySQL分析实例。<props="china"><ph>更多详情，请参见[MySQL分析实例简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）。</ph></props>

DBNodeStorage.description_en: The storage capacity of the cluster. Unit: GB

DBVersion.description_en: The database version. Only version 3.0 is supported
DBVersion.description_zh: 数据库版本，当前仅支持3.0版本

DiskEncryption.description_en:
Indicates whether disk encryption is enabled. Valid values:

true: yes.

false: no
DiskEncryption.description_zh:
是否开启云盘加密。取值：

true：是。
false：否

DiskPerformanceLevel.description_en: The performance level of the disk

DiskType.description_en:
The disk type of the cluster. Valid values:

local_ssd: local SSD.

cloud: basic disk.

cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.

cloud_essd0: ESSD PL0.

cloud_essd: ESSD PL1.

cloud_essd2: ESSD PL2.

cloud_essd3: ESSD PL3.

For more information about ESSDs, see [ESSDs]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html）
DiskType.description_zh:
集群的磁盘类型，取值说明：
local_ssd：本地磁盘。
cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_essd0：PL0等级的ESSD云盘。
cloud_essd：PL1等级的ESSD云盘。
cloud_essd2：PL2 等级的ESSD云盘。
cloud_essd3：PL3 等级的ESSD云盘。

更多关于ESSD云盘的详情，请参见[ESSD云盘规格]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html）

DtsJobId.description_en: The ID of the DTS synchronization task. This parameter is returned only for analytic instances for MySQL. <props="china">For more information, see [What is an analytic instance for MySQL?]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）.</props>
DtsJobId.description_zh: DTS同步任务ID。仅MySQL分析实例会返回该参数。<props="china"><ph>更多详情，请参见[MySQL分析实例简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）。</ph></props>

ElasticIOResource.description_en: The number of elastic I/O resources

ElasticIOResourceSize.description_en:
The specifications of a single elastic resource node. Valid values:

8Core64GB: If the specifications of a single node are 8-core 64 GB, the specifications of an elastic I/O resource group are 24-core 192 GB.

12Core96GB: If the specifications of a single node are 12-core 96 GB, the specifications of an elastic I/O resource group are 36-core 288 GB
ElasticIOResourceSize.description_zh:
弹性资源单节点规格。取值说明：
8Core64GB：单节点规格为8Core64GB时，一组弹性IO资源的规格为24Core192 GB。
12Core96GB：单节点规格为12Core96GB时，一组弹性IO资源的规格为36Core288 GB

EnableAirflow.description_en:
Indicates whether an Airflow cluster is created. Valid values:

true: An Airflow cluster is created.

false: No Airflow cluster is created
EnableAirflow.description_zh:
是否创建了Airflow集群。取值说明：
true：已创建。
false：未创建

EnableSpark.description_en:
Indicates whether a Spark cluster is created. Valid values:

true: A Spark cluster is created.

false: No Spark cluster is created
EnableSpark.description_zh:
是否创建了Spark集群。取值说明：
true：已创建。
false：未创建

Engine.description_en: The database engine of the cluster. The value is fixed as AnalyticDB

EngineVersion.description_en: The database engine version of the cluster

ExecutorCount.description_en: The number of compute nodes used in the cluster that is in flexible mode
ExecutorCount.description_zh: 弹性模式下集群使用的计算节点数量

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC. An example is 2999-09-08T16:00:00Z.

If the cluster is a subscription cluster, the actual expiration time is returned.

If the cluster is a pay-as-you-go cluster, a fixed value of 2999-09-08T16:00:00Z is returned
ExpireTime.description_zh: 集群到期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间），例如2999-09-08T16:00:00Z。 若目标集群付费模式为包年包月，则返回实际到期时间。 若目标集群付费模式为按量付费，则返回固定值2999-09-08T16:00:00Z

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true: The cluster has expired.

false: The cluster has not expired
Expired.description_zh:
集群是否过期。取值说明：
true：已过期。
false：未过期

KmsId.description_en:
The ID of the key that is used to encrypt disk data.

This parameter is returned only when disk encryption is enabled for the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
KmsId.description_zh:
用于加密云盘数据的密钥ID。
仅当AnalyticDB MySQL集群开启云盘加密时才会返回该参数

LockMode.description_en:
The lock mode of the cluster. Valid values:

Unlock: The cluster is not locked.

ManualLock: The cluster is manually locked.

LockByExpiration: The cluster is automatically locked after it expires.

LockByRestoration: The cluster is automatically locked before a rollback.

LockByDiskQuota: The cluster is automatically locked after the storage space is full. The data storage usage has reached 90% of the total storage
LockMode.description_zh:
集群的锁定模式，取值说明：
Unlock：正常（即未锁定）。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定。
LockByRestoration：集群回滚前自动锁定。
LockByDiskQuota：集群中空间满（即数据占用的存储空间已到达上限水位的90%）自动锁定

LockReason.description_en:
The reason the cluster is locked.

This parameter is returned only when the cluster is locked. Its value is always instance_expire
LockReason.description_zh:
集群锁定原因。
仅当集群被锁定时会返回该参数，固定为instance_expire

MaintainTime.description_en:
The maintenance window of the cluster. The time is in the HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ format. For example, 04:00Z-05:00Z indicates that the maintenance window is from 04:00 to 05:00.

For more information about maintenance windows, see [Set a maintenance window]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122569.html）
MaintainTime.description_zh: 集群的可维护时间段，格式为HH:mmZ- HH:mmZ，例如：04:00Z-05:00Z，表示可维护时间段为4点至5点。 更多关于可维护时间段的信息，请参见[设置可维护时间段]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122569.html）

Mode.description_en:
The mode of the cluster. Valid values:

flexible: Flexible mode.

reserver: Reserved mode.

For more information about cluster modes, see [Editions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）
Mode.description_zh:
集群模式，取值说明：
flexible：弹性模式。
reserver：预留模式。

更多关于集群模式的介绍，请参见[产品系列]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205001.html）

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the cluster. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
集群付费类型，取值说明：
Postpaid：按量付费（即后付费）。
Prepaid：包年包月（即预付费）

Port.description_en: The port number of the cluster

ProductForm.description_en:
The product form. Valid values:

LegacyForm: Legacy form.

IntegrationForm: Integrated form
ProductForm.description_zh:
产品形态枚举：
LegacyForm: 传统形态。
IntegrationForm：融合形态

ProductVersion.description_en:
The product version. Valid values:

BasicVersion: Basic Edition.

EnterpriseVersion: Enterprise Edition
ProductVersion.description_zh:
产品版本。取值为：
BasicVersion：基础版。
EnterpriseVersion：企业版

RdsInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the source RDS instance. This parameter is returned only for analytic instances for MySQL. <props="china">For more information, see [What is an analytic instance for MySQL?]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）.</props>
RdsInstanceId.description_zh: 同步源RDS实例ID。仅MySQL分析实例会返回该参数。<props="china"><ph>更多详情，请参见[MySQL分析实例简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154779.html）。</ph></props>

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the cluster

ReservedNodeCount.description_en: The number of reserved resource nodes

ReservedNodeSize.description_en: The specifications of the reserved node. Unit: AnalyticDB Compute Unit (ACU)

SecondaryVSwitchId.description_en:
The ID of the secondary vSwitch.

The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the VSwitchId parameter
SecondaryVSwitchId.description_zh:
备虚拟交换机ID。
本参数和VSwitchId参数传入的值不能相同

SecondaryZoneId.description_en:
The ID of the secondary zone.

The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the ZoneId parameter
SecondaryZoneId.description_zh:
备可用区ID。
本参数和ZoneId参数传入的值不能相同

StorageResource.description_en: The specifications of storage resources used in the cluster that is in flexible mode. These resources are used for data reads and writes. You can increase the storage resources to improve the read and write performance of the cluster
StorageResource.description_zh: 弹性模式用的存储资源规格，用于数据读写，增加该资源能提高集群读写能力

Key.description_en:
The tag key.

Call the [TagResources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179253.html） operation to create tags for the cluster
Key.description_zh:
标签键。
您可以调用[TagResources]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179253.html）接口为目标集群创建标签

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: Pending.

RUNNING: Running.

SUCCEED: Succeeded
Status.description_zh:
任务状态，取值为：
NOT_RUN：等待运行。
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCEED：已结束

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the step. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
EndTime.description_zh: 步骤结束时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the step. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
StartTime.description_zh: 步骤开始时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StepStatus.description_en:
The step status. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: Pending.

RUNNING: Running.

SUCCEED: Succeeded
StepStatus.description_zh:
步骤状态，取值为：
NOT_RUN：等待运行。
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCEED：已结束

UserENIStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the Elastic Network Interface (ENI) is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
UserENIStatus.description_zh:
是否已启用ENI（Elastic Network Interface，弹性网卡）网络，取值说明：
true：已启用。
false：未启用

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the cluster
